Svitolina announced the end of one of tennis' most high-profile relationships in an emotional post on Instagram earlier this week, where she attributed the split in part to the mental toll of Russia's ongoing war in her native Ukraine. That promoted a wave of hostility online towards the world No 6, which increased when she then confirmed that the end of the marriage had led Monfils to retire earlier than planned. messages.text: Leclerc tops first USA practice as upgraded Ferrari shows early promise

metadata.summary: Charles Leclerc showed early promise in an upgraded Ferrari car to pip Red Bull's in-form Max Verstappen to the fastest time of first practice at the United States Grand Prix.
metadata.content: United States GP: Charles Leclerc fastest in upgraded Ferrari in first practice in Austin as Mercedes rivals introduce updates | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to main content United States GP: Charles Leclerc fastest in upgraded Ferrari in first practice in Austin as Mercedes rivals introduce updates Ferrari, Red Bull, McLaren and Mercedes separated by narrow margins around COTA in Practice One; Antonelli in sixth on weekend he could clinch world title; watch second practice later on Friday at 10pm live on Sky Sports F1, with qualifying at the same time on Saturday Friday 23 October 2026 20:20, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Ted Kravitz talks through Ferrari's fourth and final upgrades for the United States Grand Prix. Charles Leclerc showed early promise in an upgraded Ferrari car to pip Red Bull's in-form Max Verstappen to the fastest time of first practice at the United States Grand Prix. Ferrari, McLaren and Red Bull all introduced fresh revisions to their cars for the opening hour of running at the Circuit of the Americas, which is staging the first leg of the sport's second of three end-of-season triple headers. Ferrari's package features changes to their car's floor, sidepod and diffuser and showed speed on both the medium and soft tyres around the undulating COTA lap, with Leclerc ultimately setting the session's pace on the latter with a best lap of 1:36.052. messages.text: Cordina: I've been offered Pacquiao fight on AJ-Fury card

metadata.summary: Welsh boxer Joe Cordina has told Sky Sports that he has been offered a fight with Manny Pacquiao as part of the undercard for the blockbuster all-British heavyweight clash between Anthony Joshua and Tyson Fury on December.
metadata.content: Joe Cordina says he's been offered Manny Pacquiao fight as part of Anthony Joshua-Tyson Fury bill in Cardiff | Boxing News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Exclusive Joe Cordina says he's been offered Manny Pacquiao fight as part of Anthony Joshua-Tyson Fury bill in Cardiff Tyson Fury and Anthony Joshua are set for December 11 showdown at the Principality Stadium in Cardiff, hometown boy Joe Cordina tells Sky Sports he has agreed to fight 47-year-old boxing icon Manny Pacquiao on the undercard but that contracts haven't yet been signed Friday 23 October 2026 20:17, UK Image: Joe Cordina says he has agreed to fight Manny Pacquiao in Cardiff on December 11 but that a contract hasn't yet been signed Welsh boxer Joe Cordina has told Sky Sports that he has been offered a fight with Manny Pacquiao as part of the undercard for the blockbuster all-British heavyweight clash between Anthony Joshua and Tyson Fury on December. The 34-year-old has confirmed that he has agreed to fight the boxing icon at the Principality Stadium in his birth city of Cardiff, but that no contracts have been signed as of yet. Sky Sports have approached Pacquiao's team for comment. Why did you choose to join Chelsea? "It was about the timing. For me, it was the right timing after Leverkusen. After Madrid, I had my time off and I wanted to have that good feeling, that good connection about where to go. "I had no link to Chelsea, but with the potential that was here, a few things could change and I thought we could start the journey together. "I had a feeling that the very strong base of the squad was very good and with some updates, some improvements, some new signings, we could have a solid team. And that it was going to be a project. messages.text: Rodgers' magnificent obsession lands in Paris

metadata.summary: A book on the shelf behind Aaron Rodgers is entitled 'A Magnificent Obsession', to which he sees the irony-meets-humour in relation to his own NFL love affair.
metadata.content: NFL Paris 2026: Aaron Rodgers and his magnificent obsession ready for more NFL history in final season of storied career | NFL News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Exclusive NFL Paris 2026: Aaron Rodgers and his magnificent obsession ready for more NFL history in final season of storied career Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers tells Sky Sports he is on the '18th green' of his NFL career amid what marks his final season; watch Rodgers' Steelers take on the New Orleans Saints at Stade de France in Paris, live on Sky Sports NFL from 1pm Sunday Friday 23 October 2026 17:01, UK A book on the shelf behind Aaron Rodgers is entitled 'A Magnificent Obsession', to which he sees the irony-meets-humour in relation to his own NFL love affair. It is the game he cannot say goodbye to, but one he will say goodbye to at the end of this season, which he has insisted shall be the last of his stellar Hall of Fame career. Just moments earlier Pittsburgh Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy had been asked about the difference in the Rodgers of now compared to the Rodgers with whom he had worked and won a Super Bowl in Green Bay. More grey hairs was the first answer. But at the age of 42 Rodgers will lead the Steelers out as a prized attraction when they face the New Orleans Saints in the NFL's historic Paris debut at Stade de France on Sunday, live on Sky Sports.
